It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Dallas Cowboys +0.9 with a fair total of 51.2 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Baltimore Ravens pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.271 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
